title: Persona
description: A declarative profile bound to an agent at configuration time. Two persona classes are distinguished by the `persona_class` discriminator: `horizontal` (cross-domain cognitive style) and `domain` (bounded expertise). The required-field set differs per class (§2.3, A5, Pass 1 Q2).

persona_class.description: Persona class discriminator (§2.3). `horizontal` reasons across domains; `domain` is bounded to a domain.

id.description: Stable persona identifier (e.g. `logician`, `legal_analyst`). Bound to an `agent` at configuration time.

reasoning_scope.description: Breadth of cognitive style the persona applies (e.g. `formal-structural`, `lateral-creative`, `evidence-based`).

reasoning_style.description: Persona's manner of reasoning (e.g. `mathematical rigor`, `lateral exploration`, `adversarial scrutiny`).

behavioral_constraints.description: Behavioral rules (e.g. cite sources when available, target criticism at reasoning not at people).

failure_modes.description: Expected failure patterns (e.g. over-confident speculation, scope drift).

output_requirements.description: Per-turn output expectations (e.g. `identify assumptions`, `list missing definitions`). Distinct from the persona role/prompt body (Pass 1 row #24b).

domain_scope.description: Domains in which the persona is competent to opine. Required for `domain` personas; absent for `horizontal` personas.

forbidden_domains.description: Domains in which the persona does not opine, paired with `must_delegate` entries. Required for `domain` personas; absent for `horizontal` personas.

must_delegate.description: Mapping from each entry in `forbidden_domains` to the persona id the agent must address via `direct_request` when that domain comes up. Required for `domain` personas.

status.description: Optional lifecycle status (Roadmap, Pass 1 row #155). MVP runtimes ignore this field.
